rule: All on-screen text is English, so films use the style's own Latin fonts. Devanagari appears only in the subtitle's Hindi line: give it its OWN font family (Deva = Poppins) and use a font stack ('500 30px Jost, Deva'); never split one family into Latin and Devanagari faces by unicode-range (Chrome drops the Latin face on some weights). Never letter-space Devanagari. Jost and Oleo Script lack the rupee sign: the stack falls back per character.

latin: Kalam Bold (headings, has the rupee sign)
devanagari: Kalam Bold has Devanagari; Patrick Hand does not, so use stack 'PH, KB'
